# `min-length-increased`

minLength increased

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `wire` |
| **Default severity** | `error` in requests, `info` in responses |
| **Rule IDs** | `min-length-increased` (both directions), `min-length-increased-in-request`, `min-length-increased-in-response` |
| **Status** | Implemented (M5) |
| **Group** | Schemas ([RULES.md section 7](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

`minLength` increased.

## Why this default

In requests: shorter strings are rejected. In responses: clients receive longer strings, which is safe.

## Example

From test case [`min-length-increased`](../../test/cases/min-length-increased/): minLength raised on a request string.

`openapi.yaml`, base → revision:

```diff
  …
          name:
            type: string
+           minLength: 1
```

Findings:

- `min-length-increased-in-request` · error · #/components/schemas/Pet

## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file, for the generic ID or any variant ID above (the more specific ID wins). See [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  min-length-increased: info
```

## How to fix

Keep the old minimum in requests.
